Title: Equipping from another minion you control

Messages.Author: mjvtes521
Messages.Body:
Vamp A and Vamp B have the same controller. If Vamp A tries to equip 1 or more equipment that Vamp B has, does Vamp A need to satisfy the requirements to equip each of those equipment? The rules just say...

To equip with an equipment card currently possessed by one of your other minions, tap the acting minion (the minion who is attempting to get the equipment) and announce the equipment card he is getting. More than one equipment card can be taken from a minion in a single action. If the action is unsuccessful, the equipment remains where it is. (6.1.3)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> mjvtes521 wrote:
> Vamp A and Vamp B have the same controller. If Vamp A tries to equip 1 or more equipment that Vamp B has, does Vamp A need to satisfy the requirements to equip each of those equipment?
>
No. Requirement only applies when you play the card (in the normal way should I add):
>
> Requirements for Playing Cards. Each library card has symbols on the attribute bar (the marble stripe on the left side) for the card type (except for master cards), the clan or Discipline (if any) required to play the card and the cost (if any) of playing that card. Some cards will have other requirements (such as capacity or title) stated in the card text. Only a minion who meets the requirements given on a minion card can play it, while only a Methuselah who controls a ready minion who meets the requirements of a master card can play it.
>
As you pointed out, nothing is specified when equipping from another minion (but it doesn't mean you'll be able to use it, depending on the cardtext).

To be exhaustive, I'll add that "putting a card in play" in an exotic way (such as Alastor) isn't equipping, and therefore requirement doesn't apply (unless stated otherwise).
